 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Los Angeles Lakers guard Bronny James blocking a social media content creator has sparked a major reaction from NBA fans. 
 With the 2026-27 NBA season right around the corner, the Los Angeles Lakers are expected to start the campaign with Bronny James on the roster.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement However, several Purple and Gold supporters are against James Jr.'s spot on the roster, especially after seeing his underwhelming pre-season performance for the team.
 Content creator Shahin Ourian is among Bronny's critics, and it has led to a major reaction from the Lakers guard.
 Bronny James called 'soft' by NBA fans over blocking LA Lakers content creator
 Being the eldest son of LeBron James has always invited a plethora of criticism for Bronny. Getting drafted by the Lakers has only added fuel to the fire.
 Keeping that in mind, Bronny must have seen Ourian's criticism of his pre-season performance. Instead of responding to him, the 22-year-old simply blocked the content creator.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement "Bronny James just blocked me from his Instagram account following the end of tonight's final Lakers preseason game.
 "Maybe he had issues with some of my content calling out his on-court struggles?" Ourian wrote on IG.
 This didn't go unnoticed by NBA fans, as they called out Bronny for getting his feelings hurt.
 "You hurt his feelings," a fan mocked. While another added, "Soft like his father." A third fan joked, "Blocked by James."
 "Good that you're calling out his struggles. Lakers need to trade Bronny," a fourth fan stated. Another added, "They should just send him to Philly with his dad and get a draft pick for him."
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement "Some people need to get rid of the distractions; he's not hurt; he's just not gonna listen to some dude talk crazy," a sixth fan wrote in support of Bronny.
 Of course, there were fans furious that Bronny blocked the creator, but some understood the Lakers star's point of view as well. After all, Ourian has rarely minced his words when talking about the guard.
